title: DocumentReleaseSearchSegment
description: One deterministic, bounded search segment. Carries its structural parent, its order, its heading path, its representation range, and reversible coordinates into the exact captured bytes. SpicySearch consumes these; it must not run a second segmentation pipeline.

structuralParentId.description: The structural node this segment came from. Never null: a segment with no source structure has no coordinates to be reversible against.

ordinal.description: Position within the document. Dense and zero-based across the whole document, so segment order is total and reconstructible.

headingPath.description: Heading text from the document root down to this segment's structural parent, outermost first. Empty when no ancestor carries a heading.

representationStart.description: Half-open [start, end) over the selected representation's UTF-8 bytes. Must lie inside the structural parent's range.

evidenceCoordinate.description: Reversible coordinates into the exact captured rendition. The rendition is named by digest rather than by path, so evidence survives any relocation of the member.

coordinateSystem.description: `rendition-utf8-byte` when the captured bytes are themselves UTF-8 text; `rendition-byte` for any other captured encoding or binary container.
